text:
The court will most likely allow the records as business records, since the defendant's testimony that he kept them regularly in the ordinary course of business supplies the core foundation under FRE 803(6), and as owner he can serve as the qualified witness. I'm changing my earlier answer of B: a greater foundation isn't what the rule requires here, and option C is wrong because a declarant's availability does not remove hearsay. Option A is the best of the choices, though the defendant's thin testimony leaves room for a challenge.

CONFIDENCE: 60
